@@ -240,9 +253,7 @@ confirm "Install Starship ${GREEN}latest${NO_COLOR} to ${BOLD}${GREEN}${BIN_DIR}
 
 info "Installing Starship, please wait…"
body:
It may make more sense if we could escalate privileges before saying "Installing, please wait..."

Maybe the flow should be:
```sh
confirm "Install Starship ${GREEN}latest${NO_COLOR} to ${BOLD}${GREEN}${BIN_DIR}${NO_COLOR}?"
check_permissions
info "Installing Starship, please wait…"
install
complete "Starship installed"
```

What are your thoughts?

I worry that the important visual queue that user interaction is needed isn't very clear with `info`:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4658208/73969837-1b8d1780-48ea-11ea-9494-f80810cac2e7.png)

What are your thoughts on using a blue exclamation mark for "input required"?
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4658208/73969954-51320080-48ea-11ea-8513-6eee64ed2a97.png)

Perhaps we should use the opportunity to explain why root privileges are needed, specifying that it's because they don't have write access to that directory:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4658208/73970875-ef729600-48eb-11ea-8398-4c65ededae02.png)

Please quote `$BIN_DIR` and change this to `if [ -w "$BIN_DIR" ]; then`
